violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, popcorn machine, and mandolines) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC placed can opener and mandolines in 3 bay sink to be washed/sanitized and took popcorn maker out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
Pulled pork was observed past the 7 day date of preparation. PIC discarded item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

Paper cup was observed being used as scoop in container of popcorn. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. PIC removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
Grease trap located in the dish washing area was not in good repair (missing lid). New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - hot chocolate prep area - cooler/prep equipment - prep tables/shelves - food storage containers (old label residue) New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The floors behind and under equipment have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. PIC refilled. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. Ice machine was taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. PIC disposed of the ice. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025

Hot dogs and hamburgers was observed held between 56-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the prep units and shelf under prep tables have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2025
The following was observed in poor repair. - ceiling tiles (previous water damage) - wall (hole) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2025
